title: The Words Written Again
old_p1: Jeremiah spoke Heavenly Father’s words out loud. His friend Baruch wrote every word on a scroll. A scroll is a long paper rolled up like a tube.
Baruch read the words in the temple, Heavenly Father’s holy house. Later the king heard them, but he did not like them. He cut the scroll into pieces and put it in his fire.
old_p2: The words were a warning: change your ways, or Babylon will come. The king did not want to change.
Then Heavenly Father told Jeremiah, “Take thee again another roll.” A roll is another scroll. So Baruch wrote all the words a second time, and even more words were added.
Heavenly Father’s words could not be lost. When something you made gets broken, you can feel brave and begin again too.
p1: The prophet Jeremiah had a friend named Baruch. Jeremiah said Heavenly Father’s words, and Baruch wrote them on a scroll. A scroll is a long paper, rolled up like a tube.
The words were a warning. Heavenly Father wanted the king and the people to stop doing wrong. Then He could forgive them, and trouble would not come.
But the king did not like the words. He cut the scroll into pieces and burned it in his fire.
p2: Then Heavenly Father told Jeremiah, “Take another scroll, and write all the words again.” So Baruch wrote them all again. They even added more words!
The king could burn a scroll, but he could not stop Heavenly Father’s words. When something you make gets broken, you can try again. Be brave, just like Baruch!
